name: Dang Vu (Matt)
paragraphs: My first job in software was as a trainee at FPT Software. It was the first time I built real software, inside a company that was already huge. I was only there a few months, but I enjoyed it, and by the end I was ready for something new.

That turned out to be Bravebits, where I worked on PageFly, a page builder Shopify merchants use to build their stores. I worked across the frontend and the backend and learned a lot. It was also the busiest time of my life, because I was holding down the job while finishing university.

PageFly was already a big, settled product when I joined. sending.ac was much younger. The product was still taking shape, and I got to build a big part of it. I took features from the first line to launch, and when something broke, I was the one who fixed it.
Thanks for reading this far. If you ever want to chat, about work or anything else, I'd really like that.
